requirements.text: For a list values, unique returns the first member of each Python == equality class, in original first-occurrence order. Nested JSON values and None elements are supported. The empty list returns [].
For list input, unique leaves the caller list and all its nested lists and dictionaries unchanged, including when removing nonadjacent duplicates.
Passing None as values raises TypeError.
